text: Giving one star, at least the staff provided good service and spoke nicely. Today I had a chance to go to have tartar removed at the clinic. The doctor is a man, very heavy handed. He told me that if it hurts, to raise my hand. I raised my hand many times and he didn't stop. How did he remove the tartar that made my face shake? It hurt so much that I had to turn my face away. He told me not to move. When I told him it hurt enough, the doctor sighed and put down the equipment like he was emotional. When he was swollen, there was a lot of blood. When I looked in the mirror, there was blood stuck in the grooves of almost every tooth. If the doctor sees this message, please make some improvements. (The doctor who wears glasses)
